violations.text: The sink used for food preparation is lacking a proper air gap (Currently equipped with an air break). The drainpipe is to be adjusted so as to not allow for the sink drain to sit below the flood rim of the air break provided. Air gap guidance printed at time of inspection. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/18/2026

The following areas of the physical facilities was observed in need of repair/adjustment... - The floor and wall junctures in the kitchen and prep areas were observed to be lacking coving. The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch. - The floor in the upstairs prep area and the downstairs ice machine area were observed to be in poor repair and in need of resealing/refinishing. The physical facilities are to be maintained in good repair. Per the PIC, more time is needed to properly refinish the floors. New Violation. Correct By: 07/31/2027
The menu was observed to be lacking an allergy awareness statement. New Violation. Correct By: 08/04/2026

The basement area used for slicing of deli meats does not have a hand-washing sink that is conveniently located and/or readily accessible. Hand-washing sinks must be located to allow convenient use by employees in food preparation, food dispensing, and ware-washing areas. Any food prep is to be discontinued in the basement area until inspected and approved by RIDOH CFP Inspector. New Violation. Correct By: 08/04/2026

Dishes and utensils were observed in the Dish Side hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Items were removed at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/04/2026

Meatballs in hot hold unit #2 were observed held at 120 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Meatballs were properly reheated on the cooktop by the PIC at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/04/2026

The following items were observed held at 44-45 degrees Fahrenheit: - An unopened deli item, perishable juice, and filo dough labeled keep frozen were observed in the basement 1 Door Freezer at 44 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Food items were moved to colder refrigeration at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/04/2026

The food items on the menu that are served to the customer's request are lacking an asterisk directing the customer to the written consumer advisory provided. Asterisk is to be added to the particular food items that could be potentially served raw/undercooked. New Violation. Correct By: 08/04/2026

Steamed Broccoli was observed cooling in a plastic wrapped 6" pan in the reach-in cooler at 78 degrees Fahrenheit. Broccoli was moved to a sheet pan and left uncovered to rapidly cool. Cooling strategies were discussed with the PIC at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/04/2026

Working containers of dry ingredients are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as nuts, seeds, flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. New Violation. Correct By: 08/04/2026

The sink used for food preparation is lacking a proper air gap (Currently equipped with an air break). The drain pipe is to be adjusted so as to not allow for the sink drain to sit below the flood rim of the air break provided. Air gap guidance printed at time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 09/04/2026

The following areas of the physical facilities was observed in need of repair/adjustment... - The floor and wall junctures in the kitchen and prep areas were observed to be lacking coving. The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch. - The floor in the upstairs prep area and the downstairs ice machine area were observed to be in poor repair and in need of resealing/refinishing. The physical facilities are to be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 12/31/2026

The basement area used for slicing deli meats is lacking proper ceiling covering (open upstairs floor structure above) and lacking floor-to-wall junctures (coving). Food prep in the basement area is to be discontinued until finished with proper surface characteristics/materials and inspected/approved by RIDOH CFP Inspector. New Violation. Correct By: 08/04/2026

Wood is used in the construction of shelving and the mixer stand in the kitchen area. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other food soiling or that require frequent cleaning must be constructed of a nonabsorbent and smooth material. Per the PIC, surfaces are to be sealed. New Violation. Correct By: 02/28/2025

The sink used for food preparation is lacking a proper air gap. A direct connection must not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food is placed. New Violation. Correct By: 01/30/2025
